tips: A day on Venus lasts longer than a year on Venus.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth.
Saturn is less dense than water.
The International Space Station circles Earth about every 90 minutes.
Neptune takes about 165 years to go once around the Sun.
Footprints on the Moon last a very long time because there is no wind there.
Australia is wider than the Moon.
The leap day makes up for Earth taking about 365.25 days to go around the Sun.
Octopuses have three hearts.
Wombats leave cube-shaped droppings.
Flamingos turn pink because of what they eat.
Kangaroos can hardly walk backwards.
Koalas have fingerprints very similar to human ones.
Honey bees use a dance to show each other where to find food.
Giraffes have the same number of neck bones as humans: seven.
Penguins live almost only in the Southern Hemisphere.
Botanically, bananas count as berries, but strawberries do not.
Bamboo is a type of grass.
Young sunflowers turn to follow the Sun.
Peanuts grow underground and are legumes.
Coast redwoods grow more than 110 metres tall.
Coffee beans are the seeds of a fruit.
A rainbow is really a circle; from the ground we usually see only part of it.
Snowflakes nearly always have a six-sided basic shape.
The largest desert in the world is Antarctica.
Mount Everest is still growing by a few millimetres a year.
Canada has the longest coastline in the world.
Russia stretches across eleven time zones.
Lake Baikal is the deepest lake in the world.
Istanbul lies on two continents.
The Amazon carries more water than any other river.
Greece has more than 6,000 islands and islets.
Earth is not a perfect sphere; it is slightly wider at the equator.
The Eiffel Tower gets a few centimetres taller in summer because of the heat.
The Eiffel Tower was originally meant to stand for only 20 years.
The Golden Gate Bridge is not golden; its colour is called “International Orange”.
The Statue of Liberty was copper-coloured at first; the green came with time.
The first modern Olympic Games took place in Athens in 1896.
The Channel Tunnel is about 50 kilometres long.
The first text message was sent in 1992 and read “Merry Christmas”.
The first website went online in 1991.
The microwave oven came about when a chocolate bar melted in an engineer's pocket.
The idea for Velcro came from burrs in a dog's fur.
The sticky note came from a glue that did not stick well enough.
The tin can was invented before the can opener.
László Bíró developed the modern ballpoint pen in the 1930s.
A piano usually has 88 keys.
Beethoven composed his 9th Symphony when he was already almost deaf.
The Mona Lisa has no visible eyebrows.
Van Gogh sold hardly any paintings in his lifetime.
A Rubik's Cube has about 43 quintillion possible positions.
In chess, estimates say there are more possible games than atoms in the observable universe.
Ice floats because water expands when it freezes.
Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air.
Diamonds and pencil leads are both made of carbon.
A lightning bolt is hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Honey keeps almost indefinitely when well sealed.
Kiwis ripen faster next to an apple.
Tomatoes usually taste better when kept out of the fridge.
Cut flowers often last longer if you trim the stems at an angle.
